evals.prompt: I need to build a Python user authentication system. It should handle user registration, login with hashed passwords, and session management. No external dependencies except bcrypt for hashing.
evals.expected_output: Python skeleton with User model, auth functions (register, login, verify_session), TODOs with detailed hints about password hashing and session validation, comprehensive test file with fixtures

evals.prompt: TypeScript: Build a shopping cart for an e-commerce app. Features: add item, remove item, calculate total, apply discount, get cart summary. Must support quantity tracking.
evals.expected_output: TypeScript skeleton with Cart class, methods for each feature with type signatures, interface for CartItem, detailed TODOs with hints, comprehensive test suite with edge cases (empty cart, negative quantity, etc.)

evals.prompt: Go: Create a simple file logger. Should write log messages with timestamps to a file, support different log levels (INFO, ERROR, DEBUG), and handle concurrent writes safely.
evals.expected_output: Go skeleton with Logger struct, methods for each log level, detailed TODOs about mutexes for concurrency and RFC3339 timestamps, comprehensive test file including goroutine safety test
